notes.title: Development Update | Roadmap To V 1.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663625/9e4f1479de7513823cd4a7299a38d7010bdd35d4.png[/img]

[h2]Exciting Update for Retro Arcade Enthusiasts![/h2]

[h3]After carefully reviewing the feedback from the recent festival Demos and considering what's best for players, I've made a thrilling decision: I’m gearing up to launch Version 1.0 of the game. I'm skipping the Early Access phase to deliver the complete, polished experience you deserve from day one!
[/h3]

The Early Access banner has been removed and some updates have been made to the store page to celebrate this update and show a more current state of the project.

As always if you wanted to get your hands on the game and access it early you can still do that through the Demo which will be updated 2-3 more times before release, the last update will reflect the full game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663625/88df0973f8d637959fadb303aac57e2475eab39f.png[/img]

Demo Version 3 is on its way, completely dedicated to implementing your feedback and adding more features. Here’s what I’m working on behind the scenes for the upcoming Demo 3:

[list]
[*] squashing bugs left and right to ensure a seamless experience
[*] fine tuning gameplay balance for maximum fun and less difficulty
[*] integrating your feedback across interface and gameplay 
[*] completing more features to enhance your experience
[*] performance is getting optimized for smoother uninterrupted gameplay
[*] interface updates for more accessibility and choice of preferences
[*] ramping up content production and polishing the existing content
[*] localization and compatibility testing to ensure everyone can enjoy the game
[/list]
From alpha to beta to release and beyond, I’m working on crafting an experience that's not just fun but a true reflection of the nostalgia of retro arcades racing delivered in a modern fashion. I started refining in late 2023, now in 2024 the playable Demo is in your hands and in 2025, you'll finally be able to dive headfirst into the full retro arcade experience!

notes.title: Steam NextFest
notes.content:
Hello to our amazing community!

In the previous road to launch post the aforementioned - [i]when it's ready it's ready[/i] comes to play again.

[b][i]The good news is you will be able to play soon,[/i][/b] we're finally releasing something soon - the demo will have highscores and be a highly replayable part of the full game, regardless of release date. Whereas the full game will have more content, environments and features to enjoy with endless updates.


Below is a list of updates that will be rolling out soon before or by February 5th for Steam NextFest:
[h3][list]
[*] new storepage screenshots and descriptions
[*] new storepage gifs showing gameplay
[*] social media reels showing graphics
[*] gameplay announcement trailer
[*] demo released on February 5th
[/list][/h3]

This is a solo developer production being created by one artist, so again thank you so much for your kind patience and support, it's really appreciated and the little activity that happens on this forum is huge motivation to keep going and make the game as great as possible for you to enjoy.


Really hope to blow you away! After all, the game's premise is nostalgia. Been working really hard on selling the feeling and emotion of speed within the game, set in a colorful, bright universe reminiscent of the happy 1980s we never got to experience, except through games and film. Thank you all so much!

notes.title: Road To Launch Day
notes.content:
[h3]Hello To Our Amazing Community![/h3]

Production is steadily continuing however as previously mentioned in our very first community update, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1628640/view/3709316537999459483][i]"worst case scenario if something doesn't work quite right, it wouldn't be right not to delay the launch."[/i][/url] we had to delay the launch to polish the game to meet our high quality release standards for 2023.

We weren't going to announce a date until we were completely certain but an internal Steamworks miscommunication required us to publish a release date. Combined with our ambition clouding judgement, resulted in an inaccurate estimation of release. We apologize for that very deeply. 

The release date has been reverted to be sometime during 2023, when it's ready. The positive side of this is that we are working to bring the game to complete polish launch day, possibly removing Early Access status altogether for release with a uniquely unforgettable experience playing for the very first time.

Here are a few development screenshots with more surprises to come as we get closer to launch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663625/caa2740d40c8c23781dbc9f16fa6ff9359d13179.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663625/8876bb387707f866feb614516ed8c7971740ae62.png[/img]

To get out more into the open, since official updates are cumbersome to assemble, we've made an official Instagram and Twitter page for slightly less official, more fun micro updates, if you'd like to follow.

Thank you so much for being with us and we look forward to sharing the video trailer soon!

notes.title: First Community Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663625/aae2f63cab81042ba927604cdd85241da94d4acb.png[/img]




[h1]WHAT IS SYNTHALGIA?[/h1] 


[h3]syn·thal·gia[/h3]

/sinTHˈôlˈjə/

[i]noun[/i]
noun: [b]synthalgia[/b]

[list]
[*] a sentimental longing or wistful affection for the age of synthesizers, typically from the period of 1980 through to 1989, with happy associations to fast cars, sunny days, beaches and bright lights

[i]"I was overcome with acute synthalgia for my days in college"[/i]
[/list]


[h1]WHAT IS THIS GAME?[/h1] 

[h3][b]SYNTHALGIA: Retro Arcade Racing[/b] is a passion project fueled by love for cars and the 1980's with nothing but a [i]vision to convey the warm happy feelings of the 1980's bottled up into the font seat of a supercar![/i][/h3]  

[i]Romanticizing everything great and nostalgic about the 1980's[/i] with aims to become the most amazing arcade racing game set in retro futuristic universe of fast cars, beaches and bright lights! Cruising the roads, shifting through gears and taking in the scenery, driving as fast and far as you can! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663625/f1d1cb85545cc45d7da46d44d61e48b310af4762.png[/img]

The initial vision for the game has been boiled down to its core essence over many sleepless nights reworking and refining in pursuit of creating the ultimate arcade driving feeling.




[h1]PLANNED RELEASE[/h1]

[i]This game is a solo developer production. It’s taken a long while with lots of effort for the game to have come this far. We do not have the budget to operate as a big studio which is both good and bad as things become more pure and refined to their core artistic essence but at the cost of time.[/i]

Aside from some photoscanned rocks and cactuses this game was designed by hand and built in-house from the ground up in a matching cohesive visual aesthetic, with focus on immersion and sense of speed. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663625/8f33b57b163ee290a94c5a676602bbf5d0e6a18c.png[/img]

Early Access launch is planned for the second quarter of this year (between April and June). However worst case scenario if something doesn't work quite right, it wouldn't be right not to delay the launch.

Shigeru Miyamoto famously said "a delayed game is eventually good, but a rushed game is forever bad" we want the Early Access release to be as great fun and exciting release as possible. 




[h1]COMMUNITY[/h1]

This game has been in development for a little over two years now. Wow. Time passes like grains of sand falling through your hands. We want to thank you for all the wishlists, follows and your interest! It's been an incredible journey making this game thus far. 

If you love what you're seeing and can’t wait for more it would be greatly appreciated if you shared the game with your friends and family, especially those who grew up in the coin arcade era. Your support and feedback is very much welcome and appreciated! 

Thank you so much!
